blocks.text: Indus Valley Civilization

The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilization that existed around 4300-1300 BCE in the Indus Valley region of modern-day Pakistan and northwestern India. It is known for its sophisticated urban planning and architecture. The civilization was discovered in the 1920s by archaeologist Daya Ram Sahni.
